skill_name: Write a story about alien invasion
workflow: It was a gloomy evening - the skies were dark and the stars had yet to shine. Suddenly, a loud rumble filled the air as strange flying objects descended from the heavens. People from all corners of the Earth ran in terror as the strange aliens invaded – this was the dawn of a new age. Cities were destroyed, lives were lost and no one knew what the aliens wanted.
